annotations.title: Dated comparisons against a customer's bank deal

description: Keyed. Returns the dated history of comparisons for one customer and corridor: the rate on each prepared or reconciled payment against that day's official rate, the negotiated deal (margin in bps or a fixed spread, with the customer's own bank label), and a public market price when one was read. Drift is in bps and in the sent currency. above_negotiated is set when the gap over the deal exceeds the stored tolerance. A missing figure is null. The payment stays with the customer's own bank. A router key is required.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

customer_id.description: Your own id for the customer whose negotiated deal is compared, e.g. 'acme'.

from.description: ISO 4217 code of the source currency (what leaves), e.g. 'ZAR'.

to.description: ISO 4217 code of the destination currency (what lands), e.g. 'USD'.
